component.name: REDIS CACHE (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)
component.description:
What it does Reads and writes keys in your organization's Redis cache - a fast place to keep session state, counters, lookups and results you do not want to compute twice.

How it works Each node runs one operation, chosen in the Inspector. Anything in ${braces} in the key, field, value or pattern is filled in from the data arriving at the node, so a key of "user:${user_id}" reaches the right user. A placeholder naming a field that is not there stops the run rather than writing to the wrong key, and a Redis error fails the run - a write is never reported as done when it was not.

Configure
- Operation - GET, SET, DELETE, HGET, HSET, HGETALL, EXISTS, KEYS or SCAN_VALUES.
- Key Prefix - an optional namespace put in front of every key and pattern.
- Key - the key to act on.
- Hash Field - the field within a hash, for HGET and HSET.
- Value - what to store, for SET and HSET; objects and lists are stored as JSON.
- TTL (seconds) - how long a written key lives; 0 keeps it forever.
- Key Pattern - which keys KEYS and SCAN_VALUES list, such as session:*.

In and out In: any data; its fields fill the placeholders. Out: a JSON result with the operation and the full key, plus value, fields, exists, deleted, keys or entries depending on the operation.

Use it when
- You want to cache a slow lookup or model answer between runs.
- Several orchestrations need to share a small piece of state.
- You want to see what is stored under a prefix while building or debugging.
component.short_description: Reads and writes keys in your organization's Redis cache, filling ${field} placeholders from incoming data.

component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: agent
name: Redis Cache
description: >
  Runs one Redis operation (GET, SET, DELETE, HGET, HSET, HGETALL, EXISTS,
  KEYS or SCAN_VALUES) against the organization's in-cluster Redis.
  ${field} placeholders in the key, field, value and pattern are filled from
  request_data. A misconfigured node or a Redis failure raises and fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # The incoming artifact is not read. Placeholders read request_data by
    # whatever name the Inspector names, so no specific inbound key is required.
    artifact_type_input: none
    artifact_type_output: json
    response_data:
      operation: string - The operation that ran.
      key: string - The full key acted on, prefix included; the full pattern for KEYS and SCAN_VALUES.
      value: string (optional) - GET and HGET - the value read, null when missing. SET and HSET - the value written.
      fields: object (optional) - HGETALL only - every field of the hash; empty when the key is missing.
      exists: boolean (optional) - EXISTS only - whether the key exists.
      deleted: boolean (optional) - DELETE only - whether a key was removed.
      keys: array (optional) - KEYS and SCAN_VALUES - the matching key names, sorted.
      entries: array (optional) - SCAN_VALUES only - key, type and value of up to 200 matching keys.

input_parameters:
  - name: operation
    type: select
    label: Operation
    options: [GET, SET, DELETE, HGET, HSET, HGETALL, EXISTS, KEYS, SCAN_VALUES]
    default: GET
    required: true
    description: The Redis operation this node runs.
  - name: key_prefix
    type: text
    label: Key Prefix
    default: ""
    description: Optional namespace put in front of every key and pattern (myapp makes myapp:key). Accepts ${field} placeholders.
  - name: key
    type: text
    label: Key
    default: "${key}"
    required: true
    description: The key to act on. Accepts ${field} placeholders.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [GET, SET, DELETE, HGET, HSET, HGETALL, EXISTS]
  - name: field
    type: text
    label: Hash Field
    default: ""
    description: The field within the hash. Accepts ${field} placeholders.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [HGET, HSET]
  - name: value
    type: text_long
    label: Value
    default: "${value}"
    description: The value to store. A placeholder that names an object or list stores it as JSON.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SET, HSET]
  - name: default_ttl_seconds
    type: integer
    label: TTL (seconds)
    default: 0
    constraints:
      min: 0
      max: 2592000
    description: Seconds until the key expires; 0 keeps it forever. HSET applies it to the whole hash.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SET, HSET]
  - name: pattern
    type: text
    label: Key Pattern
    default: "*"
    description: Glob pattern for KEYS and SCAN_VALUES (user:*, session:*). Accepts ${field} placeholders.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [KEYS, SCAN_VALUES]

key.description: The full key acted on, prefix included; the full pattern for KEYS and SCAN_VALUES.
